svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: From issue to live change
svg.desc: From issue to live change. 18 components in 8 groups. Connections: Opens an issue to Asks questions (starts the agent); Asks questions to Answers on the issue (question on the issue); Answers on the issue to Writes a proposal (clear enough); Writes a proposal to Reviews the proposal (to review); Reviews the proposal to Commits the draft (reviewed draft); Commits the draft to Publishes proposal page (push builds the page); Publishes proposal page to Gives feedback (page link on the issue); Gives feedback to Picks a sketch (agent revises them); Picks a sketch to Comments /approve (pick recorded); Comments /approve to Builds and tests (starts the build); Builds and tests to Opens pull request (tested commits); Opens pull request to Branches the data (starts the preview); Branches the data to Deploys a preview (data for the preview); Deploys a preview to Posts preview link (preview is up); Posts preview link to Merges pull request (owner checks it); Merges pull request to Deploys the site (tests pass on main); Deploys the site to Closes the issue (deploy reported).

text.tspan: How one request moves through the intentable loop
fit, fidelity; up to five rounds
The full test suite must pass
Agent: Claude Code in a Daytona sandbox
